A caller-supplied collection_name is accepted and passed, together with user and add=True when a collection name is supplied, to save_docs_to_vector_db; that call is the visible destination write path. The supplied source does not include the implementation of save_docs_to_vector_db or a connected target-specific authorization check, so it cannot establish whether the existing caller-selected collection is rejected for lacking ownership/write permission or is written. async def _validate_collection_access(collection_names: list[str], user, access_type: str = 'read') -> None:
    """
    Raise 403 if the user lacks access to any of the requested collections.
    Delegates to the shared filter_accessible_collections utility so the
    access rules stay in one place.
    """
    requested = set(collection_names)
    allowed = await filter_accessible_collections(requested, user, access_type=access_type)
    denied = requested - allowed
    if denied:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
            detail=ERROR_MESSAGES.ACCESS_PROHIBITED,
        )
